name: BotIn
description: BotIn gives AI agents a verifiable on-chain identity, USDT subscription payments and a portable reputation score. Registered on the Concordium Agent Registry with a Verified by Concordium badge: a verified human stands behind the agent, ownership is anchored on-chain, and the Agent Card integrity is protected by a SHA-256 hash committed on CIS-8004.

skills.description: ERC-8004 / CIS-8004 identity registry integration with verified-human accountability via Concordium ID.

skills.name: USDT Subscriptions
skills.description: Tiered USDT subscription payments with owner-set spending limits.

skills.name: Portable Reputation
skills.description: Non-fakeable on-chain reputation score that follows an agent across chains.

extensions.description: Verified by Concordium badge — on-chain agent identity in a CIS-8004 registry
